'''Fogg''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-skinned, blue-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], tame, [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, the rancor was slightly smaller in height than was normal for an adult member of the [[Species/Legends|species]]. It also had blue coloring across parts of its hide.<ref name="CWO" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
After slaying a rancor on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], an individual loyal to the Galactic Republic obtained Fogg as a pet.<ref name="CWO" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fogg first appeared as a companion that players of [[Sony]]'s [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] could obtain between its launch in [[2010]]<ref name="CWO" /> and shut down in [[2014]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=2014-01-24|language=English|archivedate=20140127193845}}</ref> It was a reward for the completion of the "Rancor Tracking" collection on the planet Umbara, all of the items of which were obtained by defeating a similarly colored rancor enemy on the planet. This article assumes players completed the collection as a part of 100% game completion.<ref name="CWO" />
